name: gina-lib-nunjucks-filters
description: Per-request filter registry for the nunjucks render path. Registered on the cached nunjucks.Environment via env.addFilter() in controller.render-nunjucks.js. Mirrors lib/swig-filters: same factory shape, same 7 public filters (getUrl, getWebroot, length, nl2br, addHours, addDays, addYears) — getConfig is internal and excluded from registration.
